<section_guide number="4" title="Demo Scenario" references="1,2">
<purpose>Automatically generate and show one executable Demo Scenario that covers every approved Required Acceptance Test.</purpose>

<questions>
1. Ask only when an approved Required Acceptance Test lacks executable information: what concrete starting state or input should be used for that test?
</questions>

<workflow>
Read Sections 1 and 2. If Section 3 was written, read it too and keep every tested claim inside that
explicit boundary.

When every Required Acceptance Test already has an executable starting condition, action, and pass
condition, do not ask the user to restate a flow. Automatically compose the shortest scenario that
covers every test at least once. Reuse shared setup and actions when the tests form one coherent
flow. If connecting tests would require unapproved behavior, keep separate execution blocks inside
the same Demo Scenario.

For every step, show the user action, visible expected result, and the Required Acceptance Test it
covers. The overall pass result requires every approved test to pass. Present the complete generated
scenario and its coverage, not only a summary, before asking for approval.

Do not require a separate Learning Check, experiment plan, metrics framework, interview script, or
learning decision. Do not substitute a feature list, screen tour, subjective impression, or
implementation check. A passing demo proves only that the approved product behavior runs; do not
present it as proof of user value or market validity. Do not omit a required test, invent connecting
behavior, or add product promises absent from the approved Sections.
</workflow>

<completion required="true">Confirm the Demo Scenario before saving 4.1 once.</completion>
</section_guide>
